freeze.timing: after US-003 verification and before every candidate observation

purpose: Credentialless disposable evidence protocol; not an architecture or rollout decision

candidates.readySignal: LF-JSONL frame type=ready on retained stdout

candidates.definition: PM2 7.0.3 script target is the Pi executable with --mode rpc
candidates.readySignal: proven lossless Pi RPC public stdout frame; PM2 logs are not transport

candidates.definition: Conditional separately named PM2 7.0.3 plus fixture RPC-host wrapper plus Pi --mode rpc
candidates.readySignal: wrapper public Unix-socket ready record only after Pi RPC byte pipes are retained
candidates.transport: wrapper-owned Pi byte pipes and mode-0600 runtime-root Unix socket
candidates.eligibility: only when direct RPC transport is infeasible; otherwise NOT RUN (not required by protocol)

candidates.definition: PM2 7.0.3 directly launches Pi without --mode rpc
candidates.readySignal: candidate public status plus first retained stdout event, with actual resolved mode recorded

candidates.definition: Optional PM2 7.0.3 control through an already-present compatible PTY utility
candidates.readySignal: candidate public status plus synthetic control ready event

networkProof.mechanism: fresh unprivileged user and network namespace with no non-internal interface
networkProof.unavailableOrFailed: safe NOT RUN before candidate launch

fakeProvider.infeasibleResult: dependent extension/RPC evidence is NOT RUN

protocol.byteFrameLoss: request and response byte/frame count, order, type, and SHA-256 equality

measurement.recreationPolicy: recreate and clean the complete runtime root for every measured repetition

rapidCrashLoop.definition: three forced non-zero exits within 15 seconds

faults.timeouts: censored failure at the applicable deadline; never omitted

sentinel.name: synthetic-live-unhealthy-sentinel
sentinel.symptomSurface: common public stderr/health surface available identically to every candidate
sentinel.ordinarySyntheticWork: blocked until externally observable recovery action
sentinel.creditRule: credit detection/recovery only to the actual component that observes the common public symptom and acts while the same child remains alive
sentinel.pm2Credit: only when PM2 detects and recovers while the same child remains alive

ordering.meaning: evidence ordering only; not a recommendation

environment.homes: fresh children of each runtime root
environment.ambientCredentialValuesOrAuthStores: never read, copy, inventory, or mount
environment.negativePreflight: reject prohibited key patterns, escaping paths, and non-empty disposable auth/config homes

soleSetupException.environment: same allowlisted disposable environment with no npm auth/config
soleSetupException.dependencies: offline only; cache miss is NOT RUN

process.ownership: exact PID plus /proc start-time plus parent/namespace
process.signalPolicy: revalidate exact ownership before every signal
process.cleanup: reverse dependency order; bounded TERM then five-second wait then revalidated KILL; repeatable
prohibited: PM2 command without explicit fixture PM2_HOME
process.cleanupFailure: stop graph and require human inspection

evidence.prefer: structured summaries and hashes when raw frames are unnecessary
redaction: scrub disposable home and worktree paths

decisionBoundary.selectionRequires: separate human-approved issue or ADR after terminal critics and First Mate synthesis
